Quick answers. Longer explanations stay on the linked Orient and Official facts pages.

## 1. What does “LAE” mean in Hong Kong?

Economic activity in airspace generally below about **1,000 metres** — a **policy working description**, not a Cap. 448G flying height. See [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) and [Key figures](key-figures.qmd).

## 2. Is “drone” the same as SUA?

In everyday speech, people say “drone.” Hong Kong law’s main label for light unmanned craft is **small unmanned aircraft (SUA)** under [Cap. 448G](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) (not more than **150 kg**). “Drone” is not a Cap. 448G synonym. See [Glossary · vehicles](glossary.qmd#vehicles-and-operations).

## 3. Does Hong Kong already have eVTOL or vertiport statutes?

**No dedicated Hong Kong eVTOL or vertiport statute yet.** Heavier / passenger-oriented types sit above the SUA ceiling as unconventional aircraft pending rules; “vertiport” is industry language for take-off and landing sites. Status rows: [Official status](tracker.qmd); plain language: [What is LAE?](primer.qmd).

## 4. What are Sandbox and Sandbox X?

Two **different** Hong Kong trial programmes — an early **Regulatory Sandbox** and a later **Sandbox X**. Plain wording: [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd#standing-caveats); numbers: [Key figures](key-figures.qmd).

## 5. Is the Shenzhen–Hong Kong corridor already flying?

A cross-boundary / GBA corridor is discussed in policy, but on the evidence tracked here it is **not an operating corridor yet**. See [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd#standing-caveats) and [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## 6. Is the HK$350 billion figure a government number?

**No.** About **HK$350 billion** by 2050 is an **Our Hong Kong Foundation** projection, not an HKSAR government figure. See [Key figures](key-figures.qmd) and [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## 7. Who decides what in Hong Kong?

Short roles: Working Group (strategy), **TLB** (policy bureau), **CAD** (Cap. 448G / sandbox circulars), **OFCA** (sandbox spectrum licence). Cheat sheet: [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd).

## 8. How does the business side fit together?

LAE is a **whole service** (craft, sites, traffic, operators, customers, supporting services). Who pays whom is on [How does LAE work?](business-overview.qmd); firm lists on [Companies & sectors](landscape.qmd).

## 9. Where are lectures and readings?

**Teach** menu: [Lectures](lectures.qmd) (slide PDFs and takeaways) and [Readings](readings.qmd) (documents by week). Week map: [Course overview](overview.qmd). Path tip: [How to use this site](howto.qmd).

## 10. What may I treat as settled for citation?

Use [Official status](tracker.qmd) chips — [OPEN]{.status-chip .status-open} / [WATCH]{.status-chip .status-watch} / [settled]{.status-chip .status-settled} — and dated instruments on [Timeline](dates.qmd). Definitions: [Glossary](glossary.qmd).
